conventions: Overlaying verbs with a bare material accusative (חפה, צפה + זָהָב / אֶבֶן): the ASV's supplied 'with' joins the verb's unit under rule 44, on the model of טָחוּ תָּפֵל → 'daubed ... with untempered mortar', and the material noun keeps only its own word. Applied in 3.4–3.10. Rule 33 keeps only a material or measure nominal the English attaches to a noun rather than to the verb — 'shekels of gold' (3.9), 'the veil of blue' (3.14), 'pillars of thirty and five cubits' (3.15).

Measurement clauses: where a לְ heads the predicate (לְאַמּוֹת חָמֵשׁ 3.11, לִשְׁקָלִים חֲמִשִּׁים 3.9) the construction's copula goes to that לְ under rule 49 and 'cubits'/'shekels' stays bare; where no preposition stands, the copula joins 'cubits' under rule 20 and never the numeral (3.3, 3.4, 3.8, 3.11, 3.12, 3.15). A gapped second measure the ASV writes without a copula leaves 'cubits' bare.

בֵּית קֹדֶשׁ הַקֳּדָשִׁים → 'the most holy house' is split word by word (3.8, 3.10): בַּיִת → 'house', קֹדֶשׁ → 'holy', הַקֳּדָשִׁים → 'most', with the innermost article taking the fronted 'the' under rule 29. A noncompositional 'most holy' on the two nouns was the competing reading.

In וַיְחַפֵּהוּ recast as 'which he overlaid', the relative 'which' realizes the object suffix it denotes (rule 18) and the waw is unrepresented; the competing reading gives 'which' to the waw under rule 17 and leaves the suffix unrepresented. Noted on both units.
report: Checked all 29 candidate lemmas. Nearly all differences are ASV-licensed: לְ 'to'/'for'/'of'/'amounting to', בְּ 'in'/'of'/'after'/'on', עַל־פְּנֵי 'before' vs 'according to', אֶחָד 'one'/'other'/'the other', copula on the לְ where one heads the measure predicate (3.9, 3.11) and on 'cubits' where none does (3.3, 3.4, 3.8, 3.11, 3.12, 3.15).

One real split, invisible to the lemma table because it is a helper-placement difference: the supplied 'with' before the bare material accusative after חפה/צפה. Six verses (3.5, 3.6, 3.7, 3.8, 3.9, 3.10) give it to the verb under rule 44 (on the model of טָחוּ תָּפֵל → 'daubed ... with untempered mortar'); 3.4 alone gave it to זָהָב under rule 33. 3.8 is the identical shape (וַיְחַפֵּהוּ זָהָב טוֹב → 'he overlaid it with fine gold'). Patched 3.4 to the rule-44 reading; no other unit in 3.4 changes.

BSB disagreements: the 11 Td cases are agreement articles (rule 47), the article beside a demonstrative (rule 41), and the article on a toponym rectum with no 'the' written (rule 29) — convention, not error. 3.5 waw: the 'which' of the recast clause was given to the object suffix it denotes (rule 18) and the waw left unrepresented; the competing reading (waw takes 'which', rule 17) is noted on both units and is not an error. 3.10 אֹתָם: object marker, rule 16 convention. 3.11 'their' on אָרְכָּם: the ASV recasts 'their length' as the predicate 'long' and writes no pronoun; unrepresented is right.

No promotion: the contract already places a material accusative's supplied preposition on the verb (rule 44's daubed example) and directs rule 33 to run the direct-object question first; the split was a misapplication, not a gap.
